SELECT
o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.product_id, o.quantity, o.total_price, o.order_status, o.order_date, o.delivered_date,
c.user_id AS customer_id, c.user_name AS customer_name, c.user_email AS customer_email, c.user_phone AS customer_phone, c.wallet_balance,
p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.product_description, p.product_price, p.product_status
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.user_id
INNER JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
